reasonForRerun: src/air/spark/spark-math.ts changed: six members (Matrix4.invert / lookAt / compose / multiplyMatrices / makeRotationFromQuaternion, Quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix) stopped delegating to cc.* and now carry three r180 scalar bodies, so every pixel window accepted before the change binds a different source digest. This file re-establishes the same windows, cases, comparators and strict rule against the current source; it is a re-confirmation run, not new coverage.
windowsCovered: Six windows on the widened allowlist tiers: fractional device pixel ratios 1.5 / 1.25 / 1.375 and DPR 3, across 5:4, portrait, 1:1 and ultra-wide. Same 4-case subset as the predecessor extended file.
strictRule: Unchanged from the predecessor: every RGBA8 channel byte difference must be 0, both sides non-empty, each side stable against its own repeat, zero JS + drained GL errors, identical context attributes and unmasked renderer inside one engine, source/asset digest unchanged during the run, negative control must move pixels. No tolerance, no masks.
predecessorStatus: The predecessor file is kept as the historical record of the pre-rerun source state (it documents the collector-side unit fix and the before/after artifact comparison). Its rows are no longer bound to the current src/air/spark digest and must not be cited as evidence for it.
